TUZATILDI - 'The place was fantastic and the food was just delicious.' gapi tushib qolgan edi, qo'shildi (6-mashqning 4-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi). Ex.4 10 savol, Speaking jadvali (HAS / WHEN / WHAT IT WAS LIKE / WHAT HE DID THERE), Ex.5 ro'yxati 8 so'z / 8 bo'shliq, Ex.6 5 sifat va 6 ta qarama-qarshi so'z ro'yxati, Ex.7 predloglar (with, on, at, on, down, for) skan bilan mos.

exercises.explanationUz:
XATNING TO'LIQ MATNI:

  Dear Terry,

  Greetings from Cairo! The weather is very hot
  here and I'm having a wonderful time. I'm
  staying with my friend, Abdullah. He lives in
  the centre of Cairo.

  I've been here since Monday and I've already
  done lots of things! I've already visited the
  Khan al-Khalili bazaar. We visited it on
  Tuesday. You can't imagine how noisy and
  crowded it was! I bought some lovely handmade
  souvenirs there. I have also seen the
  Pyramids and the Sphinx at Giza. I saw them
  yesterday. They were amazing. I even rode a
  camel. It was fun! I've been to a traditional
  restaurant. Abdullah took me there last
  night. I tried couscous and falafel. The
  place was fantastic and the food was just
  delicious.

  There are a lot of things I haven't done yet.
  I haven't been on a boat trip down the River
  Nile yet, and I haven't visited the Egyptian
  Museum. We are going on a boat trip tomorrow
  and we are going to visit the museum one of
  these days to see the exhibits. We are also
  going to visit Luxor. The place is famous for
  its huge temples and statues.

  Cairo is a fascinating city — you must visit
  it one day! Anyway, I'm returning to England
  on Sunday next week, so I'll call you then.

                            Best wishes,
                            Jack


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Terri,

  Qohiradan salom! Bu yerda havo juda issiq va
  men ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapman. Do'stim
  Abdulloh bilan turibman. U Qohira markazida
  yashaydi.

  Dushanbadan beri shu yerdaman va allaqachon
  ko'p ish qildim! Khan al-Khalili bozoriga
  allaqachon borganman. Uni seshanba kuni
  ko'rdik. Uning qanchalik shovqinli va
  gavjum ekanini tasavvur qila olmaysan! U
  yerdan chiroyli qo'lbola sovg'alar sotib
  oldim. Yana Gizadagi ehromlar va Sfenksni
  ko'rdim. Ularni kecha ko'rdim. Ular
  hayratlanarli edi. Hatto tuyaga ham mindim.
  Qiziq bo'ldi! An'anaviy restoranda
  bo'ldim. Abdulloh meni o'tgan kecha u yerga
  olib bordi. Kuskus va falafel yeb ko'rdim.
  Joy ajoyib edi, ovqat esa juda mazali edi.

  Hali qilmagan ko'p ishlarim bor. Hali Nil
  daryosi bo'ylab qayiqda sayohat qilmadim va
  Misr muzeyiga bormadim. Ertaga qayiqda
  sayohatga chiqamiz va shu kunlarning birida
  eksponatlarni ko'rish uchun muzeyga boramiz.
  Yana Luqsorga ham boramiz. U joy ulkan
  ma'badlari va haykallari bilan mashhur.

  Qohira — maftunkor shahar, bir kun kelib
  albatta borishing kerak! Xullas, kelasi hafta
  yakshanba kuni Angliyaga qaytaman, o'shanda
  senga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

                            Eng yaxshi tilaklar
                            bilan, Jek


⚠ XATNING GRAMMATIK TUZILIShI —
BU UNITNING ENG MUHIM DARSI:

  Xat UCh ZAMONNI aralashtiradi va har
  birining SABABI aniq:

  1) PRESENT PERFECT — VAQTI aytilmagan
     'I'VE BEEN here since Monday'
     'I've ALREADY VISITED the bazaar'
     'I HAVE ALSO SEEN the Pyramids'
     'I'VE BEEN TO a traditional restaurant'
     'I HAVEN'T BEEN on a boat trip YET'
     'I HAVEN'T VISITED the Egyptian Museum'

  2) PAST SIMPLE — ANIQ VAQT aytilgan
     'We VISITED it ON TUESDAY.'
     'I SAW them YESTERDAY.'
     'Abdullah TOOK me there LAST NIGHT.'
     'I BOUGHT some souvenirs.'
     'I TRIED couscous and falafel.'
     'I RODE a camel.'

  3) BE GOING TO — KELAJAK rejasi
     'We ARE GOING ON a boat trip tomorrow'
     'we ARE GOING TO VISIT the museum'
     'We ARE ALSO GOING TO VISIT Luxor'


ENG MUHIM NAQSh — E'TIBOR BERING:

  Jek har bir ishni AVVAL Present Perfect da
  aytadi (umumiy xabar), KEYIN Past Simple da
  tafsilotini beradi (aniq vaqt bilan):

     'I've already VISITED the bazaar.'
        (Present Perfect — xabar)
     'We VISITED it ON TUESDAY.'
        (Past Simple — aniq vaqt)

     'I have also SEEN the Pyramids.'
        (Present Perfect — xabar)
     'I SAW them YESTERDAY.'
        (Past Simple — aniq vaqt)

     'I've BEEN TO a traditional restaurant.'
        (Present Perfect — xabar)
     'Abdullah TOOK me there LAST NIGHT.'
        (Past Simple — aniq vaqt)

  BU — Unit 15 ning oltin qoidasi:
     VAQT AYTILMASA  →  Present Perfect
     VAQT AYTILSA    →  Past Simple


DIQQAT — 'SINCE MONDAY':
  'I've been here SINCE MONDAY.'
  = dushanbadan BERI

  'SINCE' — boshlanish NUQTASI
     since Monday, since 2010, since I came
  'FOR' — DAVOMIYLIK
     for three days, for two years

  Ikkalasi ham Present Perfect bilan.


DIQQAT — 'YET' QAYERDA TURADI:
  'There are a lot of things I haven't done
   YET.'
  'I haven't been on a boat trip ... YET.'

  'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA (inkor gapda).


DIQQAT — 'ALREADY' QAYERDA TURADI:
  'I've ALREADY done lots of things.'
  'I've ALREADY visited the bazaar.'

  'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA
  (tasdiq gapda).


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (xatdan):
  be    → was   → BEEN
  do    → did   → DONE
  see   → saw   → SEEN
  buy   → bought → BOUGHT
  ride  → rode  → RIDDEN
  take  → took  → TAKEN


DIQQAT — 'YOU CAN'T IMAGINE HOW ...':
  'You can't imagine HOW NOISY AND CROWDED
   IT WAS!'

  Ergash gapda so'z tartibi TO'G'RI
  (savol tartibi EMAS):
     'how noisy IT WAS'  ✓
     'how noisy WAS IT'  ✗


DIQQAT — 'ONE OF THESE DAYS':
  'one of these days' = shu kunlarning birida,
  yaqin kunlarda


DIQQAT — 'FAMOUS FOR':
  'The place is FAMOUS FOR its huge temples.'
  'famous FOR something' — predlog 'for'.

  ('famous AS' — sifat sifatida mashhur:
   'He is famous AS a singer.')


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Greetings from ... = ...dan salom
  to imagine     = tasavvur qilmoq
  crowded        = gavjum
  handmade       = qo'lbola
  a souvenir     = sovg'a, esdalik
  amazing        = hayratlanarli
  to ride        = minmoq (ride → RODE)
  couscous       = kuskus (Shimoliy Afrika taomi)
  falafel        = falafel (no'xat kotleti)
  fantastic      = ajoyib
  delicious      = juda mazali
  an exhibit     = eksponat
  Luxor          = Luqsor (Misrdagi shahar)
  a temple       = ma'bad
  huge           = ulkan
  fascinating    = maftunkor
  to return      = qaytmoq
  Anyway         = Xullas, har holda

⚠ ENG MUHIM NAQSH:
1-gap PRESENT PERFECT (vaqt yo'q),
2-gap PAST SIMPLE ('on Tuesday' — aniq vaqt).

points.uz: Uning qanchalik shovqinli va gavjum ekanini tasavvur qila olmaysan! U yerdan chiroyli qo'lbola sovg'alar sotib oldim.

points.uz: Yana Gizadagi ehromlar va Sfenksni ko'rdim. Ularni kecha ko'rdim. Ular hayratlanarli edi. Hatto tuyaga ham mindim.
points.noteUz:
Yana o'sha naqsh: 'have SEEN' (Present Perfect)
→ 'I SAW them YESTERDAY' (Past Simple).
ride → RODE.

Bu gap 4-RASMGA mos keladi (the Sphinx).

points.en: I've been to a traditional restaurant. Abdullah took me there last night. I tried couscous and falafel. The place was fantastic and the food was just delicious.
points.uz: An'anaviy restoranda bo'ldim. Abdulloh meni o'tgan kecha u yerga olib bordi. Kuskus va falafel yeb ko'rdim. Joy ajoyib edi, ovqat esa shunchaki mazali edi.
points.noteUz:
'been TO' — predlog 'to'.
'took ... LAST NIGHT' — Past Simple.
couscous, falafel — Shimoliy Afrika taomlari.

points.en: There are a lot of things I haven't done yet. I haven't been on a boat trip down the River Nile yet, and I haven't visited the Egyptian Museum.

PRESENT PERFECT INKOR + 'YET'.
'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA.
'DOWN the river' = daryo bo'ylab.

points.en: We are going on a boat trip tomorrow and we are going to visit the museum one of these days to see the exhibits.
points.uz: Ertaga qayiqda sayohatga chiqamiz va shu kunlarning birida eksponatlarni ko'rish uchun muzeyga boramiz.

BE GOING TO — kelajak REJASI (Unit 13).
'one of these days' = yaqin kunlarda.
'TO see' — maqsad.

points.uz: Yana Luqsorga ham boramiz. U joy ulkan ma'badlari va haykallari bilan mashhur.

Bu gap 7-RASMGA mos keladi (statues of lions —
Luqsordagi sfenkslar xiyoboni).

points.en: Cairo is a fascinating city — you must visit it one day! Anyway, I'm returning to England on Sunday next week, so I'll call you then.

points.noteUz:
'you MUST visit' — qat'iy tavsiya (Unit 14).
'I'M RETURNING ... on Sunday' — Present
Continuous, aniq vaqtli reja (Unit 13).
'I'LL call' — va'da (Unit 13).

exercises.instructionUz: Xatni o'qing va 4- va 7-rasmlarga mos keladigan gaplarning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
104-BETDAGI RASMLAR:
  4-rasm  =  THE SPHINX (Gizadagi ulkan haykal)
  7-rasm  =  STATUES OF LIONS (Luqsordagi
             sfenkslar xiyoboni)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  4-RASMGA MOS GAP:
     'I have also seen the Pyramids and
      THE SPHINX AT GIZA.'

     (Yana Gizadagi ehromlar va SFENKSNI
      ko'rdim.)

  7-RASMGA MOS GAP:
     'We are also going to visit Luxor.
      The place is famous for its huge temples
      and STATUES.'

     (Yana Luqsorga boramiz. U joy ulkan
      ma'badlari va HAYKALLARI bilan mashhur.)


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — KALIT SO'ZLAR:

  4-rasm  →  'THE SPHINX' so'zi xatda
             AYNAN uchraydi
  7-rasm  →  'STATUES' so'zi (Luqsor haqidagi
             gapda)


DIQQAT — 7-RASM NEGA LUQSOR:
  104-betdagi 7-rasmda ikki qator sfenks
  haykallari bor — bu Luqsordagi mashhur
  SFENKSLAR XIYOBONI (Avenue of Sphinxes).

  Xatda Luqsor faqat BIR MARTA tilga olinadi
  va aynan 'STATUES' bilan birga.


DIQQAT — ZAMONLAR FARQI:

  4-rasm gapida:  'I HAVE SEEN'
     → PRESENT PERFECT (allaqachon ko'rgan)

  7-rasm gapida:  'We ARE GOING TO VISIT'
     → BE GOING TO (hali bormagan, REJA)

  Ya'ni Jek Sfenksni KO'RGAN, lekin Luqsorga
  HALI BORMAGAN.

  Bu — mashqning yashirin darsi: bir xil
  turdagi ikki joy, lekin ZAMONLARI boshqa.


QOLGAN RASMLAR HAM XATDA BOR:
  1-rasm (Nil qayig'i)  →  'a boat trip down
                            the River Nile'
  2-rasm (bozor)        →  'the Khan al-Khalili
                            bazaar'
  3-rasm (ehrom, tuya)  →  'the Pyramids' /
                            'I even rode a camel'
  5-rasm (muzey)        →  'the Egyptian Museum'
  6-rasm (niqob)        →  'the exhibits'
                            (bilvosita)

  Kitob faqat 4 va 7 ni so'ragan, lekin
  yettalasi ham xatda aks etgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to underline = tagiga chizmoq
  to match     = mos kelmoq
  Giza         = Giza (Qohira yaqinidagi joy)
  Luxor        = Luqsor
  a temple     = ma'bad

KALIT: 'THE SPHINX' so'zi xatda aynan bor.
ZAMONI: PRESENT PERFECT — Jek uni
ALLAQACHON ko'rgan.

points.en: Picture 7 (statues of lions):  'We are also going to visit Luxor. The place is famous for its huge temples and statues.'

points.noteUz:
KALIT: 'STATUES' so'zi.
7-rasm — Luqsordagi sfenkslar xiyoboni.

ZAMONI: BE GOING TO — Jek u yerga HALI
BORMAGAN, bu faqat REJA.

⚠ 4 va 7 ning farqi shu: biri ko'rilgan,
biri rejada.

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N SAVOL — BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  Where is Jack?
    → He is in Cairo, Egypt.
    (U Misrning Qohira shahrida.)

 2  What is the weather like there?
    → It is very hot.
    (Havo juda issiq.)

 3  Who is Jack staying with?
    → He is staying with his friend, Abdullah.
    (Do'sti Abdulloh bilan turibdi.)

 4  How long has Jack been there?
    → He has been there since Monday.
    (U dushanbadan beri o'sha yerda.)

 5  What did Jack do on Tuesday?
    → He visited the Khan al-Khalili bazaar
      and bought some handmade souvenirs.
    (Khan al-Khalili bozoriga bordi va qo'lbola
     sovg'alar sotib oldi.)

 6  What did he do yesterday?
    → He saw the Pyramids and the Sphinx at
      Giza, and he rode a camel.
    (Gizadagi ehromlar va Sfenksni ko'rdi va
     tuyaga mindi.)

 7  What hasn't he done yet?
    → He hasn't been on a boat trip down the
      River Nile and he hasn't visited the
      Egyptian Museum.
    (Nil bo'ylab qayiqda sayohat qilmagan va
     Misr muzeyiga bormagan.)

 8  What is he going to do before he leaves?
    → He is going to go on a boat trip, visit
      the Egyptian Museum and visit Luxor.
    (Qayiqda sayohatga chiqadi, Misr muzeyiga
     va Luqsorga boradi.)

 9  When is he returning to England?
    → He is returning on Sunday next week.
    (Kelasi hafta yakshanba kuni qaytadi.)

10  What does he think of the place?
    → He thinks Cairo is a fascinating city.
    (Uning fikricha, Qohira maftunkor shahar.)


⚠ SAVOLNING ZAMONI JAVOBNING ZAMONINI
BELGILAYDI — BU MASHQNING ASOSIY DARSI:

  SAVOL                    JAVOB
  ─────────────────────    ──────────────────
  'WHERE IS Jack?'         'He IS in Cairo.'
     Present Simple           Present Simple

  'HOW LONG HAS he BEEN?'  'He HAS BEEN since
     Present Perfect          Monday.'
                              Present Perfect

  'What DID he DO on       'He VISITED ...'
   Tuesday?'                  Past Simple
     Past Simple

  'What HASN'T he DONE     'He HASN'T BEEN ...'
   yet?'                      Present Perfect
     Present Perfect

  'What IS he GOING TO     'He IS GOING TO ...'
   do?'                       be going to
     be going to

  Ya'ni savolni DIQQAT bilan o'qish yetarli —
  javobning zamoni o'zi ma'lum bo'ladi.


DIQQAT — 4-SAVOL, 'HOW LONG':
  'HOW LONG has Jack been there?'
  = qancha vaqtdan beri?

  Javob IKKI xil bo'lishi mumkin:
     'SINCE Monday.'  (boshlanish nuqtasi)
     'FOR a few days.' (davomiylik)

  Xatda 'SINCE Monday' berilgan.

  'How long' savoli DOIM Present Perfect
  bilan (agar hali davom etayotgan bo'lsa).


DIQQAT — 2-SAVOL, 'WHAT IS IT LIKE?':
  'What IS the weather LIKE?'
  = havo qanday?

  DIQQAT: bu yerda 'like' — 'yoqmoq' EMAS,
  'qanday' ma'nosida.

     'What is it LIKE?'   = u qanday?
     'What do you LIKE?'  = nima yoqadi?

  Javobda 'like' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     'It is very hot.'  ✓
     'It is like hot.'  ✗


DIQQAT — 10-SAVOL, 'WHAT DOES HE THINK OF':
  'What does he THINK OF the place?'
  = u joy haqida qanday fikrda?

  'think OF / think ABOUT something' —
  fikr so'rash.

  Javob: 'He thinks (that) Cairo is
  fascinating.'


DIQQAT — 8-SAVOL, 'BEFORE HE LEAVES':
  'before he LEAVES' — kelasi zamon ma'nosi,
  lekin PRESENT SIMPLE ishlatiladi!

  'before / after / when' bog'lovchilaridan
  keyin 'will' ishlatilmaydi:
     'before he LEAVES'      ✓
     'before he WILL LEAVE'  ✗


JAVOBLARDA OLMOSh O'ZGARADI:
  Xatda: 'I'm staying with MY friend'
  Javobda: 'HE is staying with HIS friend'

  Xat BIRINCHI shaxsda, javob UChINChI
  shaxsda bo'ladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  How long ...?    = qancha vaqtdan beri?
  What is it like? = u qanday?
  to think of      = ... haqida fikrda bo'lmoq
  to leave         = ketmoq, jo'namoq

points.en: 1  Where is Jack?  —  He is in Cairo, Egypt.
points.uz: Jek qayerda? — U Misrning Qohira shahrida.
points.noteUz:
Savol PRESENT SIMPLE → javob ham Present
Simple.
Xatning sarlavhasidan: 'Greetings from CAIRO!'

points.en: 2  What is the weather like there?  —  It is very hot.
points.uz: U yerda havo qanday? — Juda issiq.
points.noteUz:
'What is it LIKE?' = u qanday?
('like' bu yerda 'yoqmoq' EMAS).
Javobda 'like' TAKRORLANMAYDI.

points.en: 3  Who is Jack staying with?  —  He is staying with his friend, Abdullah.
points.uz: Jek kim bilan turibdi? — Do'sti Abdulloh bilan.
points.noteUz:
'stay WITH somebody' — predlog 'with'.
DIQQAT: 'MY friend' → 'HIS friend'.

points.en: 4  How long has Jack been there?  —  He has been there since Monday.
points.uz: Jek u yerda qancha vaqtdan beri? — Dushanbadan beri.
points.noteUz:
'HOW LONG has ... been?' — PRESENT PERFECT
savoli, javob ham Present Perfect.
'SINCE Monday' — boshlanish nuqtasi.

points.en: 5  What did Jack do on Tuesday?  —  He visited the Khan al-Khalili bazaar and bought some handmade souvenirs.
points.uz: Jek seshanba kuni nima qildi? — Khan al-Khalili bozoriga bordi va qo'lbola sovg'alar sotib oldi.
points.noteUz:
Savol PAST SIMPLE ('did ... do') → javob ham
Past Simple ('visited', 'bought').
Xatda: 'We visited it ON TUESDAY.'

points.en: 6  What did he do yesterday?  —  He saw the Pyramids and the Sphinx at Giza, and he rode a camel.
points.uz: U kecha nima qildi? — Gizadagi ehromlar va Sfenksni ko'rdi va tuyaga mindi.
points.noteUz:
PAST SIMPLE ('saw', 'rode').
Xatda: 'I SAW them YESTERDAY ... I even RODE
a camel.'
ride → RODE.

points.en: 7  What hasn't he done yet?  —  He hasn't been on a boat trip down the River Nile and he hasn't visited the Egyptian Museum.
points.uz: U hali nima qilmagan? — Nil bo'ylab qayiqda sayohat qilmagan va Misr muzeyiga bormagan.
points.noteUz:
Savol PRESENT PERFECT INKOR → javob ham
shunday.
'YET' — hali (gap oxirida).
IKKI ish sanaladi.

points.en: 8  What is he going to do before he leaves?  —  He is going to go on a boat trip, visit the Egyptian Museum and visit Luxor.
points.uz: Ketishidan oldin u nima qilmoqchi? — Qayiqda sayohatga chiqadi, Misr muzeyiga va Luqsorga boradi.
points.noteUz:
BE GOING TO — reja.
UCH ish sanaladi.

DIQQAT: 'before he LEAVES' — 'before' dan
keyin PRESENT SIMPLE ('will leave' XATO).

points.en: 9  When is he returning to England?  —  He is returning on Sunday next week.
points.uz: U Angliyaga qachon qaytadi? — Kelasi hafta yakshanba kuni.
points.noteUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — aniq vaqtli reja
(Unit 13).
Xatda: 'I'm RETURNING to England ON SUNDAY
next week.'

points.en: 10  What does he think of the place?  —  He thinks Cairo is a fascinating city.
points.uz: U bu joy haqida qanday fikrda? — Uning fikricha, Qohira maftunkor shahar.
points.noteUz:
'think OF something' = ... haqida fikrda
bo'lmoq.
Xatda: 'Cairo is a FASCINATING city.'

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter again, then copy the table and complete it. In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatni yana o'qing, so'ngra jadvalni ko'chirib to'ldiring. Juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVALNING TO'RT USTUNI:
  HAS  |  WHEN  |  WHAT IT WAS LIKE  |
  WHAT HE DID THERE

Kitob BIRINCHI qatorni to'ldirib bergan
(namuna).


TO'LIQ JADVAL:

 ┌────────────────┬──────────┬─────────────┬──────────────┐
 │ HAS            │ WHEN     │ WHAT IT WAS │ WHAT HE DID  │
 │                │          │ LIKE        │ THERE        │
 ├────────────────┼──────────┼─────────────┼──────────────┤
 │ visited the    │ Tuesday  │ noisy &     │ bought       │
 │ Khan al-Khalili│          │ crowded     │ souvenirs    │
 │ bazaar         │          │             │  (NAMUNA)    │
 ├────────────────┼──────────┼─────────────┼──────────────┤
 │ seen the       │ yesterday│ amazing     │ rode a camel │
 │ Pyramids and   │          │             │              │
 │ the Sphinx     │          │             │              │
 ├────────────────┼──────────┼─────────────┼──────────────┤
 │ been to a      │ last     │ fantastic   │ tried        │
 │ traditional    │ night    │ (food was   │ couscous and │
 │ restaurant     │          │ delicious)  │ falafel      │
 └────────────────┴──────────┴─────────────┴──────────────┘


HAR USTUN QAYERDAN OLINADI:

  HAS  →  Present Perfect gaplaridan
     'I've already VISITED the bazaar'
     'I have also SEEN the Pyramids'
     'I've BEEN TO a traditional restaurant'

  WHEN →  Past Simple gaplaridagi VAQTDAN
     'We visited it ON TUESDAY'
     'I saw them YESTERDAY'
     'Abdullah took me there LAST NIGHT'

  WHAT IT WAS LIKE →  SIFATLARDAN
     'how NOISY AND CROWDED it was'
     'They were AMAZING'
     'The place was FANTASTIC'

  WHAT HE DID THERE →  qo'shimcha
  harakatlardan
     'I BOUGHT some souvenirs'
     'I even RODE A CAMEL'
     'I TRIED couscous and falafel'


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA DIALOG:

  SA: HAS Jack VISITED the Khan al-Khalili
      bazaar?
  SB: Yes, he HAS.
  SA: WHEN DID he VISIT it?
  SB: On Tuesday.
  SA: What WAS it LIKE?
  SB: It WAS noisy and crowded.
  SA: What DID he DO there?
  SB: He BOUGHT some souvenirs.


⚠ ENG MUHIM GRAMMATIK DARS —
ZAMON ALMAShUVI:

  1-savol:  'HAS Jack VISITED ...?'
            → PRESENT PERFECT
            (vaqt aytilmagan)
  Javob:    'Yes, he HAS.'

  2-savol:  'WHEN DID he VISIT it?'
            → PAST SIMPLE
            ('when' — ANIQ vaqt so'ralyapti!)
  Javob:    'On Tuesday.'

  Ya'ni birinchi savol Present Perfect da,
  lekin 'WHEN' so'ralishi bilan zamon
  PAST SIMPLE ga o'tadi.

  BU — Unit 15 ning eng muhim qoidasi:
     'Has he visited?' ✓ (vaqt yo'q)
     'When HAS he visited?' ✗ XATO
     'When DID he VISIT?'  ✓


QOLGAN IKKI QATOR UChUN TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

  SA: Has Jack seen the Pyramids and the
      Sphinx?
  SB: Yes, he has.
  SA: When did he see them?
  SB: Yesterday.
  SA: What were they like?
  SB: They were amazing.
  SA: What did he do there?
  SB: He rode a camel.

  SA: Has Jack been to a traditional
      restaurant?
  SB: Yes, he has.
  SA: When did he go there?
  SB: Last night.
  SA: What was it like?
  SB: It was fantastic and the food was
      delicious.
  SA: What did he do there?
  SB: He tried couscous and falafel.


DIQQAT — 'WHAT WAS IT LIKE?' va
'WHAT WERE THEY LIKE?':
  Ega BIRLIK bo'lsa   →  'What WAS IT like?'
  Ega KO'PLIK bo'lsa  →  'What WERE THEY like?'

  Ehromlar va Sfenks — KO'PLIK, shuning uchun
  'What WERE THEY like?' va 'They WERE
  amazing.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  crowded    = gavjum
  amazing    = hayratlanarli
  fantastic  = ajoyib
  a souvenir = sovg'a, esdalik

'WHEN DID he VISIT?' (Past Simple).
'When HAS he visited?' — XATO!

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish uchun ro'yxatdan so'z tanlang, so'ngra ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta so'z, har biri BIR marta):
  rode, handmade, fascinating, centre, huge,
  boat, traditional, wonderful


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  HUGE temples
  2  having a WONDERFUL time
  3  in the CENTRE of Cairo
  4  TRADITIONAL restaurant
  5  HANDMADE souvenirs
  6  a BOAT trip
  7  I RODE a camel
  8  a FASCINATING city


HAMMASI XATDAN OLINGAN:
  1  'its HUGE temples and statues'
  2  'I'm having a WONDERFUL time'
  3  'He lives in the CENTRE of Cairo'
  4  'I've been to a TRADITIONAL restaurant'
  5  'some lovely HANDMADE souvenirs'
  6  'a BOAT trip down the River Nile'
  7  'I even RODE a camel'
  8  'Cairo is a FASCINATING city'


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — IKKI GURUH:

  YETTITASI SIFAT yoki OT ANIQLOVChISI
  (otdan OLDIN turadi):
     HUGE temples
     WONDERFUL time
     TRADITIONAL restaurant
     HANDMADE souvenirs
     BOAT trip
     FASCINATING city
     CENTRE (of Cairo — ot)

  BITTASI FE'L:
     'I RODE a camel'
     Ro'yxatdagi yagona FE'L shakli —
     'rode' (ride ning o'tgan zamoni).
     Bo'shliqdan oldin 'I' bor, demak FE'L
     kerak!


ENG NOZIK JOY — 7-BAND:
  'I ................ a camel'

  Bo'shliqdan oldin EGA ('I'), keyin
  TO'LDIRUVCHI ('a camel') — orasida FE'L
  bo'lishi shart.

  Ro'yxatda faqat BITTA fe'l bor: RODE.


DIQQAT — 3-BAND, 'CENTRE':
  'in the CENTRE of Cairo'

  'centre' — britancha yozilishi.
  Amerikacha: 'center'.

  Shu kabi: theatre/theater, metre/meter,
  litre/liter.


DIQQAT — 'BOAT TRIP' — OT + OT:
  'a BOAT trip' — birinchi ot ikkinchisini
  aniqlaydi (qanday sayohat? — qayiqda).

  Shu kabi: a bus stop, a school bag,
  a football match.

  DIQQAT: birinchi ot KO'PLIKDA bo'lmaydi:
     'a boat trip'  ✓
     'a boats trip' ✗


DIQQAT — 'HANDMADE':
  hand + made = qo'l bilan yasalgan
  Qo'shma sifat, birga yoziladi.

  Shu kabi: homemade (uyda tayyorlangan),
  handwritten (qo'lda yozilgan).


DIQQAT — 'FASCINATING' va 'FASCINATED':
  'a FASCINATING city' = maftunkor shahar
     (-ING: narsaning XUSUSIYATI)
  'I am FASCINATED' = men maftun bo'ldim
     (-ED: odamning HISSI)

  Shu kabi: interesting/interested,
  boring/bored, exciting/excited.


GAP TUZISh — NAMUNA GAPLAR:

 1  Luxor is famous for its HUGE TEMPLES.
 2  We are having a WONDERFUL TIME in Egypt.
 3  My hotel is IN THE CENTRE OF the city.
 4  We ate at a TRADITIONAL RESTAURANT last
    night.
 5  I bought some HANDMADE SOUVENIRS at the
    bazaar.
 6  We are going on a BOAT TRIP tomorrow.
 7  I RODE A CAMEL near the Pyramids.
 8  Cairo is a FASCINATING CITY.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  huge        = ulkan
  wonderful   = ajoyib
  the centre  = markaz
  traditional = an'anaviy
  handmade    = qo'lbola
  a boat trip = qayiqda sayohat
  to ride     = minmoq (ride → RODE)
  fascinating = maftunkor

commonMistake.whyUz:
XATDAN: 'The place is famous for its HUGE
TEMPLES and statues.'

Ma'badlar QANDAY? — ulkan.
'huge' = juda katta (very big dan kuchliroq).

XATDAN: 'I'm having a WONDERFUL TIME.'

'to have a wonderful/good/great time' —
turg'un ibora (ajoyib vaqt o'tkazmoq).

6-mashqda uning ziddi so'raladi: 'horrible'.

XATDAN: 'He lives IN THE CENTRE OF Cairo.'

'centre' — bu ro'yxatdagi yagona OT
(qolganlari sifat yoki fe'l).
'in the centre OF' — ikki predlog.

DIQQAT: 'centre' britancha;
amerikacha 'center'.

XATDAN: 'I've been to a TRADITIONAL
RESTAURANT.'

Restoran QANDAY? — an'anaviy (mahalliy
taomlar beriladigan).

6-mashqda uning ziddi so'raladi: 'modern'.

XATDAN: 'I bought some lovely HANDMADE
SOUVENIRS there.'

Sovg'alar QANDAY? — qo'lda yasalgan.

'handmade' = hand + made (qo'shma sifat,
BIRGA yoziladi).
Shu kabi: homemade, handwritten.

XATDAN: 'a BOAT TRIP down the River Nile'

'a boat trip' — OT + OT birikmasi
(qanday sayohat? — qayiqda).

DIQQAT: birinchi ot KO'PLIKDA bo'lmaydi:
  'a boat trip'  ✓
  'a boats trip' ✗

Shu kabi: a bus stop, a school bag.

XATDAN: 'I even RODE A CAMEL. It was fun!'

⚠ ENG NOZIK BAND:
Bo'shliqdan oldin EGA ('I'), keyin
TO'LDIRUVCHI ('a camel') — orasida FE'L
kerak.

Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA fe'l — RODE.
Qolgan hammasi sifat yoki ot.

ride → RODE → RIDDEN (noto'g'ri fe'l).

XATDAN: 'Cairo is a FASCINATING CITY.'

Shahar QANDAY? — maftunkor, qiziqarli.

DIQQAT — '-ING' va '-ED' FARQI:
  'a FASCINATING city' — narsaning XUSUSIYATI
  'I am FASCINATED' — odamning HISSI

Shu kabi: interesting/interested,
boring/bored.

exercises.instructionEn: Replace the adjectives in bold with their opposites.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfdagi sifatlarni ularning ziddi bilan almashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ZID SO'ZLAR RO'YXATI (6 ta):
  disgusting, cold, quiet, horrible, empty,
  modern


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  I'm having a WONDERFUL time.
    → I'm having a HORRIBLE time.

 2  The streets are NOISY and CROWDED.
    → The streets are QUIET and EMPTY.

 3  We've been to a TRADITIONAL restaurant.
    → We've been to a MODERN restaurant.

 4  The food was DELICIOUS.
    → The food was DISGUSTING.

 5  The weather is very HOT.
    → The weather is very COLD.


OLTI ZID JUFTLIK:

  wonderful   ↔  horrible
  (ajoyib)       (dahshatli)

  noisy       ↔  quiet
  (shovqinli)    (jim, tinch)

  crowded     ↔  empty
  (gavjum)       (bo'sh)

  traditional ↔  modern
  (an'anaviy)    (zamonaviy)

  delicious   ↔  disgusting
  (juda mazali)  (jirkanch, badbo'y)

  hot         ↔  cold
  (issiq)        (sovuq)


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDA IKKI SIFAT:
  'The streets are NOISY and CROWDED.'
  Ikkalasi ham qalin harfda, demak
  IKKALASINI ham almashtirish kerak:
     noisy   → quiet
     crowded → empty

  Boshqa bandlarda bittadan.
  Jami 6 sifat, 6 zid so'z — teng.


HAMMASI XATDAN OLINGAN:
  1  'I'm having a WONDERFUL time'
  2  'how NOISY and CROWDED it was'
  3  'a TRADITIONAL restaurant'
  4  'the food was just DELICIOUS'
  5  'The weather is very HOT here'

  Ya'ni bu mashq — xatning TESKARI
  variantini yozish.


DIQQAT — 'DELICIOUS' va 'DISGUSTING':
  delicious  = juda mazali (ovqat haqida)
  disgusting = jirkanch, badbo'y

  'disgusting' — juda kuchli salbiy so'z.
  Yumshoqrog'i: 'not very nice', 'awful'.


DIQQAT — 'QUIET' va 'QUITE' — ADAShTIRMANG!
  QUIET  /ˈkwaɪət/  = jim, tinch (SIFAT)
  QUITE  /kwaɪt/    = ancha (RAVISH)

  'a quiet street'  = tinch ko'cha
  'quite noisy'     = ancha shovqinli

  Yozilishi juda o'xshash, ma'nosi butunlay
  boshqa!


DIQQAT — 'CROWDED' va 'EMPTY':
  crowded = odam to'la, gavjum
  empty   = bo'sh (hech kim/narsa yo'q)

  'a crowd' = olomon (OT)
  'crowded' = gavjum (SIFAT)


DIQQAT — 'HORRIBLE':
  Unit 14 da ham bor edi (99 va 103-betlar):
  'It looks and smells HORRIBLE.'

  'wonderful' ning ziddi sifatida
  'terrible', 'awful' ham bo'lardi, lekin
  ro'yxatda 'horrible' berilgan.


TO'LIQ TESKARI XAT (mashqning natijasi):
  'The weather is very COLD here and I'm
   having a HORRIBLE time. The streets are
   QUIET and EMPTY. We've been to a MODERN
   restaurant. The food was DISGUSTING.'

  Ya'ni butunlay teskari ta'til!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  horrible   = dahshatli
  quiet      = jim, tinch
  empty      = bo'sh
  modern     = zamonaviy
  disgusting = jirkanch
  cold       = sovuq
  crowded    = gavjum
  delicious  = juda mazali

pairs.whyUz:
wonderful ↔ HORRIBLE

'I'm having a HORRIBLE time.'
= Dahshatli vaqt o'tkazyapman.

'horrible' Unit 14 da ham bor edi:
'It looks and smells horrible.' (99-bet)

noisy ↔ QUIET

'The streets are QUIET.'

⚠ 'QUIET' va 'QUITE' NI ADASHTIRMANG:
  QUIET /ˈkwaɪət/ = jim (SIFAT)
  QUITE /kwaɪt/   = ancha (RAVISH)

Yozilishi o'xshash, ma'nosi butunlay boshqa!

crowded ↔ EMPTY

'The streets are EMPTY.'

DIQQAT: 2-bandda IKKI sifat qalin harfda,
shuning uchun IKKALASINI ham almashtirish
kerak.

'a crowd' = olomon (OT)
'crowded' = gavjum (SIFAT)

pairs.left: 3  We've been to a TRADITIONAL restaurant.
pairs.whyUz:
traditional ↔ MODERN

'We've been to a MODERN restaurant.'

DIQQAT: gap PRESENT PERFECT da
('We've BEEN TO') — sifat almashsa ham
zamon O'ZGARMAYDI.

delicious ↔ DISGUSTING

'The food was DISGUSTING.'

'disgusting' — juda kuchli salbiy so'z.
Yumshoqrog'i: 'not very nice', 'awful'.

Grammar 63-bet, 13-mashq: 'it TASTED AWFUL'.

hot ↔ COLD

'The weather is very COLD.'

Eng oddiy juftlik, lekin unutmang:
'cold' — ham SIFAT (sovuq), ham OT
(shamollash).
Coursebook 101-bet: 'I've got A COLD'
(shamolladim) va 'I feel COLD' (sovqotdim).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing prepositions, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Yetishmayotgan predloglarni qo'ying, so'ngra ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR RO'YXATI (5 ta):
  for, down, on, with, at

DIQQAT: OLTI bo'shliq bor, lekin BESH
predlog — demak BITTASI IKKI marta
ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  I'm staying WITH my friend
  2  ON Tuesday
  3  AT Giza
  4  go ON a boat trip DOWN the River Nile
  5  famous FOR

  'ON' IKKI marta ishlatiladi (2 va 4).


HAMMASI XATDAN OLINGAN:
  1  'I'm staying WITH my friend, Abdullah.'
  2  'We visited it ON Tuesday.'
  3  'the Pyramids and the Sphinx AT Giza'
  4  'a boat trip DOWN the River Nile' /
     'We are going ON a boat trip tomorrow'
  5  'The place is famous FOR its huge temples'


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'STAY WITH somebody' = birovnikida turmoq
    'with' — hamrohlik.
    DIQQAT: 'stay AT a hotel' (joy),
    lekin 'stay WITH a friend' (odam).

 2  'ON Tuesday' — HAFTA KUNLARI 'on' bilan:
       on Monday, on Friday, on Sunday
    Boshqa vaqt predloglari:
       IN + oy/yil/fasl (in May, in 2010)
       AT + soat (at 5 o'clock)

 3  'AT Giza' — kichik joy nomi 'at' bilan.
    'AT' — aniq nuqta.
    ('IN Cairo' — katta shahar; 'AT Giza' —
     aniq joy.)

 4  IKKI PREDLOG:
    'go ON a boat trip' — sayohatga chiqmoq
       ('on a trip / on holiday / on a
        journey' — turg'un)
    'DOWN the River Nile' — daryo BO'YLAB
       (oqim yo'nalishida)
       Teskarisi: 'UP the river'

 5  'FAMOUS FOR something' = ... bilan mashhur
    'famous FOR its temples'

    DIQQAT: 'famous AS' — boshqa ma'no
    ('He is famous AS a singer' = qo'shiqchi
     sifatida mashhur).


VAQT PREDLOGLARI — QISQA JADVAL:

  AT  →  soat, aniq vaqt
         at 5 o'clock, at night, at noon
  ON  →  kun, sana
         on Tuesday, on 5th May, on Monday
         morning
  IN  →  oy, yil, fasl, qism
         in May, in 2010, in summer,
         in the morning

  DIQQAT — ISTISNO:
     'in the morning' — 'IN' bilan
     'ON Monday morning' — 'ON' bilan
     (kun qo'shilsa 'on' bo'ladi!)


JOY PREDLOGLARI — QISQA JADVAL:

  AT  →  aniq nuqta: at Giza, at the door,
         at the bus stop, at home
  IN  →  ichida: in Cairo, in the room,
         in Egypt
  ON  →  yuzasida: on the table, on the wall


GAP TUZISh — NAMUNA GAPLAR:

 1  I'm staying WITH my friend in Cairo.
 2  We visited the bazaar ON Tuesday.
 3  The Pyramids and the Sphinx are AT Giza.
 4  We are going ON a boat trip DOWN the
    River Nile.
 5  Luxor is famous FOR its huge temples and
    statues.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to stay with = birovnikida turmoq
  Giza         = Giza (ehromlar joylashgan joy)
  to go on a trip = sayohatga chiqmoq
  down the river = daryo bo'ylab
  famous for   = ... bilan mashhur

commonMistake.whyUz:
'STAY WITH somebody' = birovnikida turmoq.
'with' — hamrohlik bildiradi.

DIQQAT — FARQI:
  'stay WITH a friend' (ODAM bilan)
  'stay AT a hotel'    (JOYDA)

Xatdan: 'I'm staying WITH my friend,
Abdullah.'

HAFTA KUNLARI DOIM 'ON' bilan:
  on Monday, on Tuesday, on Sunday

VAQT PREDLOGLARI:
  AT + soat  (at 5 o'clock)
  ON + kun   (on Tuesday)
  IN + oy/yil (in May, in 2010)

Xatdan: 'We visited it ON Tuesday.'

'AT' — aniq, kichik joy uchun.

FARQI:
  'IN Cairo'  — katta shahar (ichida)
  'AT Giza'   — aniq joy/nuqta

Xatdan: 'the Pyramids and the Sphinx AT GIZA'

Giza — Qohira yaqinidagi joy, u yerda uchta
buyuk ehrom va Sfenks bor.

'GO ON a trip' — TURG'UN ibora.

Shu kabi:
  go ON holiday, go ON a journey,
  go ON a boat trip, go ON an excursion

DIQQAT: 'on' bu mashqda IKKI marta ishlatiladi
(2 va 4a-bandlar) — chunki 6 bo'shliq, 5 predlog.

Xatdan: 'We are GOING ON A BOAT TRIP
tomorrow.'

'DOWN the river' = daryo BO'YLAB
(oqim yo'nalishida).

Teskarisi: 'UP the river' (oqimga qarshi).

Nil JANUBDAN SHIMOLGA oqadi, shuning uchun
'down the Nile' — shimolga qarab.

Xatdan: 'a boat trip DOWN THE RIVER NILE'

'FAMOUS FOR something' = ... bilan mashhur.

DIQQAT — 'FAMOUS AS' BILAN ADASHTIRMANG:
  'famous FOR its temples' = ma'badlari bilan
     mashhur (NARSA)
  'famous AS a singer' = qo'shiqchi sifatida
     mashhur (KIM sifatida)

Xatdan: 'The place is FAMOUS FOR its huge
temples and statues.'

wordFormation.introUz: 105-bet — Present Perfect va Past Simple farqi, sayohat lug'ati.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ PRESENT PERFECT va PAST SIMPLE — OLTIN QOIDA
groups.explanationUz: Xatning butun tuzilishi shu qoidaga qurilgan.
Present Perfect uchun III shakl (V3) kerak.

patterns.exampleEn: I've already visited the bazaar. We visited it on Tuesday.
patterns.exampleUz: Bozorga allaqachon borganman. Uni seshanba kuni ko'rdik.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ XATNING ASOSIY NAQSHI:
Avval PRESENT PERFECT (umumiy xabar),
keyin PAST SIMPLE (aniq vaqt bilan tafsilot).

patterns.formula: HAS + [ega] + [V3] ... ?  —  Yes, he HAS.  —  WHEN DID he [V1] it?  —  On Tuesday.
patterns.exampleEn: Has Jack visited the bazaar? — Yes, he has. — When did he visit it? — On Tuesday.
patterns.exampleUz: Jek bozorga borganmi? — Ha. — Qachon borgan? — Seshanba kuni.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'WHEN' so'ralishi bilan zamon PAST SIMPLE
ga o'tadi.
'When HAS he visited?' — XATO!

patterns.exampleEn: I've been here since Monday. I've been here for three days.
patterns.exampleUz: Dushanbadan beri shu yerdaman. Uch kundan beri shu yerdaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
SINCE — boshlanish NUQTASI (Monday, 2010)
FOR — DAVOMIYLIK (three days, two years)

patterns.exampleEn: I haven't been on a boat trip yet. There are a lot of things I haven't done yet.
patterns.exampleUz: Hali qayiqda sayohat qilmadim. Hali qilmagan ko'p ishlarim bor.

patterns.formula: WHAT IS / WAS + [ega] + LIKE?  —  It IS / WAS + [sifat].
patterns.exampleEn: What is the weather like? — It is very hot. What was it like? — It was noisy and crowded.
patterns.exampleUz: Havo qanday? — Juda issiq. U qanday edi? — Shovqinli va gavjum edi.

patterns.exampleEn: The place is famous for its huge temples and statues.
patterns.exampleUz: U joy ulkan ma'badlari va haykallari bilan mashhur.
patterns.explanationUz:
'famous FOR' — narsa bilan mashhur.
'famous AS' — kim sifatida mashhur.
